parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated request submissions. This parameter value is generated by the client. The value must be unique among different requests, can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters, and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The new name of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~144594~~) operation to query the current instance name.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the zone ID.
